facts.name: Certificate Purpose
facts.sentence: This certificate serves as evidence of coverage under the Master Group Policy.

facts.name: Master Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: The Master Group Policy is issued to the employer.

facts.name: Master Policy Precedence
facts.sentence: In case of conflict between this certificate and the Master Policy, the Master Policy controls.

facts.name: Coverage Governed by Master Policy
facts.sentence: Coverage is subject to the terms, conditions, and exclusions in the Master Policy.

facts.name: Certificate Terms Authority
facts.sentence: Coverage is also subject to the terms, conditions, and exclusions in this certificate.

facts.name: Eligibility Start Date
facts.sentence: Eligibility for coverage began on the date of hire.

facts.name: Automatic Basic Coverage Activation
facts.sentence: Basic coverage became effective automatically upon eligibility.

facts.name: Basic Coverage Without Evidence
facts.sentence: No evidence of insurability was required for basic coverage to become effective.

facts.name: Voluntary Enrollment Deadline
facts.sentence: Enrollment in voluntary coverage was required within 31 days of hire.

facts.name: Late Enrollment Rules
facts.sentence: If enrollment occurs more than 31 days after hire, late entrant provisions apply.

facts.name: Basic Life Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The basic life benefit equals two times the annual base salary.

facts.name: Basic Benefit Rounding Rule
facts.sentence: The basic life benefit is rounded to the next higher $1,000.

facts.name: Voluntary Coverage Increments
facts.sentence: Voluntary supplemental coverage can be elected in increments of $10,000.

facts.name: Max Voluntary Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum voluntary supplemental coverage is five times the employee’s salary.

facts.name: Annual Benefit Recalibration
facts.sentence: The basic benefit is recalculated annually on the policy anniversary.

facts.name: Salary-Based Benefit Recalculations
facts.sentence: Salary changes trigger a recalculation of the basic benefit.

facts.name: Maximum Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum total coverage cannot exceed $1,000,000.

facts.name: Election Increments
facts.sentence: Additional coverage can be elected in increments of $10,000.

facts.name: Max Elective Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum elective coverage is limited to five times the employee's salary.

facts.name: Annual Benefit Recalibration
facts.sentence: Basic benefit is recalculated annually on the policy anniversary.

facts.name: Salary-Based Recalculation
facts.sentence: Recalculations are based on the employee’s current salary.

facts.name: Coverage Termination Triggers
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following events: the date the Master Policy terminates; the last day of the month in which the employee ceases to be eligible; the date the employee ceases active full-time employment; the date the employee requests termination of voluntary coverage; the last day for which required premiums have been paid.

facts.name: Conversion Privilege Eligibility
facts.sentence: If group coverage terminates due to reasons other than non-payment of premium, the employee may convert to an individual whole life policy.

facts.name: No Medical Proof for Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion to an individual whole life policy does not require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline
facts.sentence: An application for conversion must be submitted within 31 days of termination of group coverage.

facts.name: Conversion Age Determination
facts.sentence: The converted policy is issued at the employee’s attained age at the time of conversion.

facts.name: Conversion Premium Rates
facts.sentence: The converted policy uses standard premium rates for the individual policy.

facts.name: Conversion Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount available under the conversion policy is the lesser of the original group coverage amount or $200,000.

facts.name: Conversion Without Medical Exam
facts.sentence: No medical exam is required for conversion to an individual whole life policy.

facts.name: Coverage Portability After Employment Termination
facts.sentence: If an employee leaves employment, they may port their coverage as an individual policy.

facts.name: Coverage Amount Preservation
facts.sentence: Ported coverage maintains the same amount that was in effect under the group policy.

facts.name: Portability Application Deadline
facts.sentence: Application for portability must occur within 31 days of termination of employment.

facts.name: Ported Coverage Premium Rates
facts.sentence: Premiums for ported coverage are age-banded group rates.

facts.name: Ported Coverage Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums for ported coverage are payable directly to the insurance company.

facts.name: No Medical Proof for Portability
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability is not required for portability.

facts.name: Group Coverage Provision
facts.sentence: Insurance company provides group coverage.

facts.name: Portability Without Medical Exam
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability is not required for portability.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Qualification
facts.sentence: A terminal illness diagnosis with a life expectancy of 12 months or less qualifies for accelerated death benefit.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Benefit Access
facts.sentence: An insured person may request acceleration of up to 75% of their death benefit if diagnosed with a terminal illness.

facts.name: Minimum Acceleration Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum amount that can be accelerated is $5,000.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that can be accelerated is $250,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Adjustment
facts.sentence: The accelerated amount will be reduced by an actuarial discount.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Any amount accelerated reduces the death benefit payable to beneficiaries.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within 12 Months
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within 12 months of the coverage effective date, no death benefit will be paid.

facts.name: No Pre-Existing Condition Exclusions
facts.sentence: Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Process
facts.sentence: Beneficiary changes can be made at any time by submitting a change form to the employer's HR department.

facts.name: Estate Payout Rule
facts.sentence: If no beneficiary survives the insured, benefits will be paid to the estate.

facts.name: Equal Division Rule
facts.sentence: When multiple beneficiaries are named, benefits are divided equally unless specified otherwise.

facts.name: Claim Notification Requirement
facts.sentence: Beneficiaries should notify Alliance Group Benefits immediately upon the death of the insured employee.

facts.name: Claim Form Requirement
facts.sentence: Required documents for filing a claim include a completed claim form.

facts.name: Claim Form Availability
facts.sentence: The claim form is available from either the employer or the insurer.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Beneficiary Verification Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of beneficiary identity is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims must be submitted to the Alliance Group Benefits - Claims Department.

facts.name: Claims Mailing Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for claims submission is 1200 Insurance Plaza, Dallas, TX 75201.

facts.name: Claims Hotline Contact
facts.sentence: The claims hotline number is 1-888-555-CLAIM.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Benefits will be paid within 10 business days of receiving a complete claim.

facts.name: Waiver of Premium
facts.sentence: Section 11 covers the Waiver of Premium.

facts.name: Premium Waiver for Disability
facts.sentence: If a person becomes totally disabled before age 60, their voluntary life insurance premiums may be waived.

facts.name: Six-Month Disability Requirement
facts.sentence: Total disability must last for 6 consecutive months to qualify for premium waiver.

facts.name: Continued Coverage During Disability
facts.sentence: Coverage continues without premium payment during disability.

facts.name: Annual Disability Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of continuing disability must be provided annually.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Termination
facts.sentence: Waiver of premiums ends when the individual returns to work.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Termination on Recovery
facts.sentence: Waiver of premiums ends when the individual recovers from disability.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Ends at Age 65
facts.sentence: Waiver of premiums ends when the individual reaches age 65.

facts.name: Definition of Disability
facts.sentence: Disability is defined as the complete inability to perform the material and substantial duties of the insured's regular occupation due to sickness or injury.

facts.name: Definition of Terminal Illness
facts.sentence: Terminal Illness is defined as a medical condition expected to result in death within 24 months as certified by a physician.

facts.name: Definition of Chronic Illness
facts.sentence: Chronic Illness is defined as the inability to perform at least two of six Activities of Daily Living for at least 90 consecutive days.

facts.name: Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: We will pay the death benefit if the insured dies while the policy is in force and all required premiums have been paid.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Timeline
facts.sentence: Payment of the death benefit will be made within 30 days of receipt of satisfactory proof of death.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If death results from suicide within two years of the policy issue date, only the total amount of premiums paid will be returned, without interest.

facts.name: Waiver of Premium Due to Disability
facts.sentence: Rider 1 is titled 'Waiver of Premium Due to Disability'.

facts.name: Annual Premium for Rider 1
facts.sentence: The annual premium for Rider 1 is $102.

facts.name: Waiver Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The premium for Rider 1: Waiver of Premium Due to Disability is $102 per year.

facts.name: Disability Premium Waiver Eligibility
facts.sentence: Rider 1 applies if the insured becomes totally disabled before age 60.

facts.name: Disability Duration Requirement
facts.sentence: Rider 1 requires the insured to remain disabled for 6 consecutive months.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Due to Disability
facts.sentence: Under Rider 1, all future premiums are waived if the condition is met.

facts.name: Waiver Maintains Full Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage under Rider 1 continues in full force if the waiver is activated.

facts.name: Waiver Duration Conditions
facts.sentence: The waiver under Rider 1 remains in effect until the insured recovers, returns to work, or reaches age 65.

facts.name: Disability Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: Annual proof of continuing disability must be submitted under Rider 1.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Benefit Free
facts.sentence: Rider 2: Accelerated Death Benefit - Terminal Illness has a premium included at no charge.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit – Terminal Illness
facts.sentence: Rider 2 allows access to up to 95% of the death benefit while alive if diagnosed with a terminal illness.

facts.name: Minimum Advance Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum advance available under Rider 2 is $10,000.

facts.name: Maximum Advance Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum advance available under Rider 2 is $500,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount in Terminal Illness Benefit
facts.sentence: The accelerated benefit under Rider 2 is reduced by an actuarial discount of approximately 8% per year.

facts.name: Remaining Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The remaining death benefit under Rider 2 is paid to beneficiaries upon the insured's death.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Rider Premium
facts.sentence: Rider 3: Accelerated Death Benefit - Chronic Illness has a premium of $48 per year.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Eligibility
facts.sentence: Rider 3 applies if the insured becomes chronically ill and cannot perform two or more Activities of Daily Living.

facts.name: Activities of Daily Living Definition
facts.sentence: Activities of Daily Living include bathing, dressing, eating, toileting, transferring, and continence.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Monthly Access
facts.sentence: Under Rider 3, the insured may access up to 2% of the face amount per month.

facts.name: Max Advance Limit – Chronic Illness
facts.sentence: The maximum total advance under Rider 3 is 50% of the face amount.

facts.name: No Actuarial Discount – Chronic Illness
facts.sentence: No actuarial discount is applied to advances under Rider 3.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: A licensed healthcare practitioner must certify chronic illness status under Rider 3.

facts.name: Children's Rider Premium
facts.sentence: Rider 4: Children's Term Insurance Rider has a premium of $156 per year.

facts.name: Child Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: Rider 4 provides $15,000 coverage for each eligible child.

facts.name: Child Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: Eligible children include all natural and legally adopted children.

facts.name: Child Coverage Duration
facts.sentence: Child coverage under Rider 4 begins at birth or adoption and lasts until age 25.

facts.name: Automatic Future Child Coverage
facts.sentence: Future children born to or adopted by the insured are automatically covered under Rider 4.

facts.name: No Medical Exam for Child Coverage
facts.sentence: No medical exam is required for child coverage under Rider 4.

facts.name: Child Conversion Rights
facts.sentence: Children covered under Rider 4 may convert to an individual policy at age 25 without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Rights Limit
facts.sentence: Conversion rights under Rider 4 allow conversion up to five times the rider amount.

facts.name: Child Covered Under Term Rider
facts.sentence: Christopher Bennett Jr. is a covered child under Rider 4 and is aged 8.

facts.name: Child Covered Under Rider 4
facts.sentence: Olivia Grace Bennett is a covered child under Rider 4 and is aged 5.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit Premium
facts.sentence: Rider 5: Accidental Death Benefit has a premium of $94 per year.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Rider 5 pays an additional $750,000 if death results from accidental injury.

facts.name: Accident Cause Requirement
facts.sentence: For Rider 5, the accident must be the direct cause of death.

facts.name: Accidental Death Time Limit
facts.sentence: Death under Rider 5 must occur within 90 days of the accident.

facts.name: Death Benefit Rider Cost
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the base policy is $94.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit pays an additional $750,000 if death results from accidental injury.

facts.name: Direct Cause Requirement
facts.sentence: An accident must be the direct cause of death to qualify for the Death Benefit.

facts.name: 90-Day Post-Accident Deadline
facts.sentence: Death must occur within 90 days of the accident to qualify for the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion
facts.sentence: Suicide is excluded from qualifying for the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Exclusion: Self-Inflicted Injury
facts.sentence: Self-inflicted injury is excluded from qualifying for the Death Benefit.

facts.name: War Exclusion
facts.sentence: War-related deaths are excluded from qualifying for the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Aviation accidents involving the insured as pilot or crew member are excluded from qualifying for the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Drug Influence Exclusion
facts.sentence: No payment is made by the Death Benefit if the insured was under the influence of drugs at the time of death.

facts.name: Alcohol Influence Exclusion
facts.sentence: No payment is made by the Death Benefit if the insured was under the influence of alcohol at the time of death.

facts.name: Death Benefit Termination Age
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit terminates when the insured reaches age 70.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Rider Cost
facts.sentence: The rider known as RIDER 6: GUARANTEED INSURABILITY OPTION has an annual premium of $89.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Option
facts.sentence: RIDER 6 allows the purchase of additional life insurance coverage without undergoing medical underwriting.

facts.name: Additional Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: Up to $100,000 of additional coverage can be purchased per option date using RIDER 6.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Option Dates
facts.sentence: Option dates for RIDER 6 include age 40.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Option Dates
facts.sentence: Option dates for RIDER 6 include age 43.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Option Dates
facts.sentence: Option dates for RIDER 6 include age 46.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Option Dates
facts.sentence: Option dates for RIDER 6 include age 49.

facts.name: Child Birth/Adoption Options
facts.sentence: Option dates for RIDER 6 include the birth or adoption of a child.

facts.name: Exercise Deadline for Additional Coverage
facts.sentence: The insured must exercise the right to purchase additional coverage within 90 days of an option date.

facts.name: Premium Determination for Additional Coverage
facts.sentence: The premium for any additional coverage purchased via RIDER 6 is determined by the insured’s age and risk classification at the time of exercise.

facts.name: Rider 6 Termination Age
facts.sentence: All options under RIDER 6 terminate when the insured reaches age 50.

facts.name: Total Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The total annual premium for the base policy plus all riders is $1,089.00.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due on July 12 of each year.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payment
facts.sentence: Payment mode for the premium is annually.

facts.name: Flexible Payment Options
facts.sentence: Monthly payment mode is available upon request.

facts.name: Quarterly Payment Availability
facts.sentence: Quarterly payment mode is available upon request.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A grace period of 31 days applies after the due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage remains active during the grace period.

facts.name: Grace Period Claim Adjustment
facts.sentence: If death occurs during the grace period, the unpaid premium will be deducted from the death benefit.

facts.name: Guaranteed Renewal Until Age 95
facts.sentence: This policy is guaranteed renewable until the insured reaches age 95.

facts.name: Increasing Renewal Premiums
facts.sentence: Renewal premiums increase according to the renewal rate schedule.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Rights
facts.sentence: The policyholder may convert all or part of this policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Renewal to Age 95
facts.sentence: This policy is guaranteed renewable to age 95.

facts.name: Renewal Premium Increases
facts.sentence: Premiums increase upon renewal according to the renewal rate schedule.

facts.name: No Evidence of Insurability Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion from this policy to permanent life insurance is allowed without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Timing
facts.sentence: Conversion can occur before the policy expiration date.

facts.name: Early Conversion Eligibility
facts.sentence: Conversion can occur before the insured’s 70th birthday.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline Rule
facts.sentence: The earlier of the policy expiration date or the insured’s 70th birthday determines the latest possible conversion date.

facts.name: Minimum Conversion Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum amount that can be converted is $50,000.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: The insurer will not contest this policy after it has been in force for 2 years during the insured's lifetime.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause Exception
facts.sentence: The only exception to the incontestability clause is non-payment of premiums.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Waiver
facts.sentence: The standard aviation exclusion has been waived for this policy.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Waiver
facts.sentence: The aviation exclusion waiver applies due to the insured's declared private pilot activities.

facts.name: Aviation Waiver Premium Cost
facts.sentence: An additional annual premium of $175 is included in the base premium for the aviation exclusion waiver.

facts.name: Aircraft Operation Coverage
facts.sentence: Death coverage includes operating an aircraft.

facts.name: Passenger Aircraft Coverage
facts.sentence: Death coverage includes riding as a passenger in any aircraft.

facts.name: Aviation Waiver Exclusion: Military Combat
facts.sentence: Death during military combat operations is excluded from coverage under the aviation waiver.

facts.name: Zero-day notice requirement
facts.sentence: A policy requires zero days' written notice.

facts.name: Rider Addition Requirements
facts.sentence: Adding riders to a policy may require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Policy
facts.sentence: Beneficiary changes can be made at any time via a written request.

facts.name: Document Issuance Location
facts.sentence: This document was issued in Denver, Colorado.

facts.name: CEO Signature Confirmation
facts.sentence: The President and CEO of ProtectPlus Family Insurance Co. signed the document.

facts.name: Signature Authority
facts.sentence: The signature on the document belongs to the President and CEO of ProtectPlus Family Insurance Co.

facts.name: Issue Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The date of issue for the document is July 12, 2024.

facts.name: Issuer Identification
facts.sentence: ProtectPlus Family Insurance Co. is the issuing company of this document.

facts.name: No Benefit on First Death
facts.sentence: When the first insured dies, no death benefit is paid.

facts.name: Policy Continuation After First Death

facts.name: First Insured Death Documentation
facts.sentence: The death certificate of the first insured must be filed with the insurer.

facts.sentence: The coverage amount remains unchanged after the first insured’s death.

facts.sentence: The annual premium of $32,400 is guaranteed level for the first 10 policy years.

facts.name: Premium Increase After Year 10
facts.sentence: After Year 10, the premium may increase.

facts.name: Premium Cap After Year 10
facts.sentence: After Year 10, the premium will never exceed $48,600 per year.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable annually on August 20th.

facts.name: Premium Continuation After First Death
facts.sentence: Premiums continue to be payable after the first death.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $48,600.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable annually on August 20th.

facts.name: Premium Continuation After First Death
facts.sentence: After the first death, premiums continue at the same rate.

facts.name: No Premium Waiver on Joint Policies
facts.sentence: Premium waiver is not available on joint survivorship policies.

facts.name: Grace Period Before Policy Cancellation
facts.sentence: If payment is not received, there is a 60-day grace period before the policy cancels.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: This policy accumulates cash value on a guaranteed schedule.

facts.name: Projected Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Projected cash value at the end of Year 10 is $285,000 based on current assumptions.

facts.name: Projected Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: Projected cash value at the end of Year 20 is $712,000 based on current assumptions.

facts.name: Loan Availability After Two Years
facts.sentence: Policy loans become available after the policy has been in force for 2 years.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit: 90%
facts.sentence: Maximum policy loan amount is 90% of the cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Interest rate for policy loans is variable and currently 5.5% per annum.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timing
facts.sentence: Policy loans are available before or after the first death.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted under this policy type.

facts.name: Policy Split After First Death
facts.sentence: Upon the first death, the policy owner may elect to split the policy into two separate single-life policies.

facts.name: Split Election Deadline
facts.sentence: The election to split must occur within 2 years of the first death.

facts.name: Actuarial Allocation of Face Amounts
facts.sentence: Each resulting policy’s face amount is determined by actuarial allocation.

facts.name: Split Option Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: Both insured individuals must be alive at the time of the first death for the split option to apply.

facts.name: Split Option Limitations
facts.sentence: The split option is available only in rare cases involving simultaneous deaths with medical uncertainty.

facts.name: Split Option Requirement
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability may be required when exercising the split option.

facts.name: Split Option Usage Rarity
facts.sentence: The split option is rarely exercised.

facts.name: Split Option Purpose
facts.sentence: The primary purpose of the split option is for divorce or trust modification situations.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Effect
facts.sentence: If either insured commits suicide within 2 years of the issue date, the death benefit is affected.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Trigger
facts.sentence: The suicide clause applies if either insured commits suicide within two years of the issue date.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: If the suicide clause applies, the death benefit is limited to the return of premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Reset on Reinstatement
facts.sentence: The suicide clause resets if the policy is reinstated.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy may be contested for material misrepresentation within two years of the issue date.

facts.name: Contestability While Both Alive
facts.sentence: Contestability only applies while both insureds are alive.

facts.name: No War Exclusions
facts.sentence: No war exclusions apply to this policy.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Absence
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusions apply to this policy.

facts.name: No Travel Exclusions
facts.sentence: No travel exclusions apply to this policy.

facts.name: Trust Ownership Structure
facts.sentence: This policy is owned by an irrevocable trust.

facts.name: Estate Tax Exclusion via Irrevocable Trust
facts.sentence: The purpose of owning the policy through an irrevocable trust is to exclude proceeds from the insureds' taxable estates.

facts.name: Trust-based Estate Exclusion
facts.sentence: Proceeds paid to the trust should not be includable in either insured's estate.

facts.name: Trust Structure & Estate Exclusion
facts.sentence: Proper structuring and maintenance of the trust are required for the proceeds to avoid inclusion in the insureds' estates.

facts.name: Trust Transfer Tax Implications
facts.sentence: An estate planning attorney should be consulted about the three-year lookback rule if the policy is transferred to a trust.

facts.name: Crummey Power Requirements
facts.sentence: An estate planning attorney should be consulted about Crummey power requirements when transferring the policy to a trust.

facts.name: Annual Exclusion Gift Planning
facts.sentence: An estate planning attorney should be consulted about annual exclusion gift planning related to the policy transfer.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Payout Rule
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same accident or incident and it cannot be determined who died first, the death benefit will be paid immediately.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Rule
facts.sentence: If both insureds die within thirty days of each other, their deaths will be treated as simultaneous for claim purposes.

facts.name: Policy Owner: Trust
facts.sentence: The policy owner is the Trust.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Rights
facts.sentence: The Trust has the right to designate beneficiaries under the policy.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Control
facts.sentence: The Trust has the right to change beneficiaries under the policy.

facts.name: Trust Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The Trust has the right to assign the policy.

facts.name: Trust Loan Rights
facts.sentence: The Trust has the right to take policy loans.

facts.name: Trust Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The Trust has the right to surrender the policy.

facts.name: Insured Ownership Limitation
facts.sentence: Neither insured has ownership rights under the policy unless specifically granted in the trust document.

facts.name: Trustee Authorization Required
facts.sentence: Assignment of the policy requires authorization from the trustee.

facts.name: Ownership Rights Condition
facts.sentence: Neither insured has ownership rights unless specified in the trust document.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Restriction
facts.sentence: A policy may not be assigned without trustee authorization.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The policy owner may cancel the policy within 30 days of policy receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Refund
facts.sentence: A full refund of premium paid is available upon cancellation within 30 days of policy receipt.

facts.name: Return of Premium Term Policy
facts.sentence: This is a Return of Premium (ROP) Term Life Insurance Policy.

facts.sentence: The policy term duration is 20 years.

facts.sentence: If the insured survives the 20-year term, 100% of all premiums paid will be returned to the policy owner.

facts.name: Return of Premium Amount

facts.name: Return of Premium on Survival
facts.sentence: The policy returns $32,400 to the policy owner if the insured survives the 20-year term and all premiums have been paid.

facts.name: Life Protection During Term
facts.sentence: The policy provides life insurance protection during the term.

facts.name: Conversion to Permanent Insurance
facts.sentence: The policy includes the option to convert to permanent insurance.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: If the insured dies during the policy term while the policy is in force, $300,000 will be paid to the beneficiary.

facts.name: Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The death benefit payment is $300,000.

facts.name: Death Benefit + Refund
facts.sentence: The death benefit is payable in addition to any proportional premium refund.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate must be submitted by beneficiaries when filing a claim.

facts.name: Claim Form Requirement
facts.sentence: A completed claim form must be submitted by beneficiaries when filing a claim.

facts.name: ID Requirement for Claims
facts.sentence: A government-issued ID must be submitted by beneficiaries when filing a claim.

facts.name: End of Term ROP Date
facts.sentence: The policy term ends on September 15, 2044.

facts.name: End-of-Term Return of Premium
facts.sentence: If the insured is alive on September 15, 2044, and all premiums have been paid, the policy owner will receive $32,400.

facts.name: End-of-Term ROP Amount
facts.sentence: $32,400 represents 100% of the premiums paid over 20 years.

facts.name: Return of Premium by Surrender Timing
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered before the end of the term, the return of premium depends on the year of surrender.

facts.name: No Return in First Five Years
facts.sentence: During Years 1–5 of the policy, no premium return is given upon surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender Return: 30%
facts.sentence: During Years 6–10 of the policy, 30% of premiums paid are returned upon surrender.

facts.name: Surrender Return: Years 11–15
facts.sentence: During Years 11–15 of the policy, 60% of premiums paid are returned upon surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender ROP: Years 16–19
facts.sentence: During Years 16–19 of the policy, 90% of premiums paid are returned upon surrender.

facts.name: Full Premium Return at Maturity
facts.sentence: At Year 20 of the policy, 100% of premiums paid are returned upon surrender.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: If death occurs during the term, beneficiaries receive the full death benefit amount of $300,000.

facts.name: Proportional Refund Upon Death
facts.sentence: If death occurs during the term, beneficiaries also receive a proportional premium refund based on the early surrender schedule.

facts.name: ROP Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: ROP payments are made within 60 days of the applicable event date.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $1,620.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due each September 15.

facts.name: Level Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: Premiums remain level throughout the term and will not increase.

facts.name: Full ROP Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: To qualify for the full return of premium at the end of the term, all premiums must be paid.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $1,620.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due on September 15 each year.

facts.name: Level Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: Premiums are level and will not increase during the term.

facts.name: Full ROP Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: To receive the full return of premium at the end of the term, all premiums must be paid on time.

facts.name: Grace Period for Premium Payments
facts.sentence: A grace period of 31 days is provided for premium payments.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Late Payment
facts.sentence: If the premium is not paid within the grace period, the policy lapses.

facts.name: Lapse Triggers ROP Forfeiture
facts.sentence: If the policy lapses due to unpaid premium, the return of premium benefit is forfeited.

facts.name: No Late Payment Recovery
facts.sentence: Missed premiums cannot be made up.

facts.name: Late Payment Penalty
facts.sentence: If a premium is paid late during the grace period, the return of premium benefit is reduced by 10%.

facts.name: Conversion Without Evidence
facts.sentence: You may convert this policy to a permanent life insurance policy without providing evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Availability
facts.sentence: Conversion is available at any time before the policy expires.

facts.name: Conversion Eligibility Age Limit
facts.sentence: Conversion is also available before the insured's 65th birthday.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline Constraint
facts.sentence: The earlier of the two dates determines when conversion must occur: either before policy expiration or before the insured turns 65.

facts.name: Minimum Conversion Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum conversion amount is $50,000.

facts.name: Maximum Conversion Amount
facts.sentence: The maximum conversion amount is $300,000.

facts.name: Maximum Conversion Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum conversion amount equals the current face amount of the policy.

facts.name: Conversion Premium Based on Attained Age
facts.sentence: Upon conversion, the new policy’s premium is based on the attained age of the insured.

facts.name: Conversion Forfeits ROP Benefit
facts.sentence: Upon conversion, the return of premium benefit is forfeited.

facts.name: Premiums Not Refunded on Conversion
facts.sentence: Upon conversion, premiums paid to date are not returned.

facts.name: No Policy Loans Allowed
facts.sentence: Policy loans are not available under this policy type.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted under this policy.

facts.name: Accessing Cash Value Methods
facts.sentence: The only ways to access cash value are through full surrender with applicable return of premium percentage or waiting until the end of the term for full return of premium payment.

facts.name: Accessing Cash Value Methods
facts.sentence: The only ways to access cash value are through full surrender with an applicable ROP percentage or waiting until the end of the term for full ROP payment.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the issue date, the insurer will pay only the premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable if the insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the issue date.

facts.name: Contestability Period for Misrepresentation
